text:
maya: Quick sketch — thinking about a collapse/minimize affordance on multi-series charts. Small chevron on each legend row that collapses the series into a mini-sparkline. Also we need a clear fallback when there are extreme outliers (e.g. a point > 100x median) — idea: hide the extreme points and surface a tiny badge that says "3 outliers hidden" (click to expand). Screenshot attached.

diego: Nice idea. Naming question: 'collapse' vs 'minimize' vs 'compress'? 'Collapse' sounds destructive.

rachel: +1 on wording concern. I prefer 'minimize' — friendlier for screen readers. Also add explicit aria-labels like `Minimize series: CPU usage`.

alex: :thinking_face: If we minimize, how do we show there are hidden values? A badge with tooltip seems good: '3 extreme points hidden (click to expand)'.

maya: Badge + tooltip sounds good. Proposed microcopy for tooltip: '3 extreme points hidden. Expand to view.' Thoughts?

diego: Shorten to '3 outliers hidden' to match other places that use 'outlier'.

rachel: Accessibility nit: tooltips must be keyboard-focusable and announced. Implementation example:```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="series-1-details">3 outliers hidden</button>
```
Use `aria-expanded` when the series is expanded. Also ensure the tooltip content is in DOM for screen readers.

pablo: Product note: +1 on 'outliers'. Also we should emit analytics event `series_collapse` with a reason payload (`outlier_threshold` or `manual_click`) so we can tune thresholds later.

emily: Visuals: when minimized, keep the series color and show a tiny median marker on the mini-sparkline so trends are still readable. If smoothing is enabled on the main chart, indicate that the mini-sparkline is smoothed with a dashed stroke or subtle label.

maya: Behavior question — should collapse be automatic when a point is extreme, or manual? I propose: auto-suggest (one-time banner) when a huge spike is detected, but default to manual. If user accepts or manually collapses, persist preference per-user.

alex: I'm wary of auto-collapse. For release metrics a single spike may be important. Suggest default manual with a non-modal suggestion: 'Large spike detected — minimize large values?' with Undo.

diego: Also add a legend context menu item: 'Show extreme as separate series / Highlight outliers' — gives power users a quick path.

rachel: Keyboard journey: make the badge focusable and add a shortcut (maybe `c`) to toggle minimize on the selected series. Document in keyboard shortcuts.

maya: I'll update the mocks and add two copy options (friendly vs terse) and a11y annotations. Will post new frames later today. Thanks all :green_heart:

alex: Thumbs up. If you want, I can run a small usability check with 3 teammates after the new frames land.

maya: Please do. Posting updated assets in this thread when ready.
